code: import axios from'axios';const API_BASE=process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL||'http://localhost:8000';const api=axios.create({baseURL:API_BASE,headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}});export const sendEmergency=async emergency=>{try{const response=await api.post('/webhook/emergency',emergency);return response.data;}catch(error){console.error('Error sending emergency:',error);throw error;}};export const getStats=async()=>{try{const response=await api.get('/stats');return response.data;}catch(error){console.error('Error getting stats:',error);return{total_emergencies:0,insured_count:0,uninsured_count:0,high_risk_count:0};}};export const getAlerts=async()=>{try{const response=await api.get('/alerts/recent');return Array.isArray(response.data)?response.data:[];}catch(error){console.error('Error getting alerts:',error);return[];}};export default api;
